newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell Philippines ops unfazed by small LPG fire.
newsitem.headline: Shell Philippines ops unfazed by small LPG fire.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp said on Tuesday that two trucks caught fire inside its liquefied petroleum gas facility in Manila but that operations were barely affected.
"I don't see any much delay in our operations ... Except when we were removing the damaged trucks out of the facility," Pilipinas Shell spokesman Ed Mapa told Reuters.
The two trucks were contracted by Shell to deliver liquefied petroleum gas and caught fire on Monday afternoon. The fire was contained after 30 minutes.
Earlier, Shell said its loading facility was partly damaged by the fire, but Mapa said the fire was confined to the two trucks.
Pilipinas Shell is a subsidiary of the Royal Dutch Shell Group.
